reasons.plan: There is a loose go-wide core around Adeline (Worthy Knight, Divine Visitation, Inquisitorial Rosette, Springjack Shepherd), but well over a fifth of the deck is off-plan filler like Dawn-Blessed Pennant, Tsabo's Web, Righteous Avengers, Darksteel Brute and Celestial Mantle.
reasons.fit: Removal is still scarce and clunky (Arbalest Elite, Tower of Calamities, Molten-Tail Masticore, Loran), and obviously weak cards like Dawn-Blessed Pennant, Tsabo's Web and Sunlit Hoplite remain, so the request is met in name only.
reasons.mana: Mono-white colours are dependable, but 45 lands (43 Plains plus two tapped lands) is at the very top of the range and too many for a curve centred on 3 drops.
reasons.ramp: Only Commander's Sphere, Darksteel Ingot and Luck Bobblehead ramp, with Foundry Inspector a minor discount, which is too little for a deck running several 6-7 drops.
reasons.draw: There are many one-shot cantrips (Novice Inspector, Fountain of Renewal, Implement of Improvement, Scroll of Avacyn, Wrench, Combat Thresher, Tsabo's Web), but the only real repeatable sources are Loran of the Third Path and the conditional Harper Recruiter.
reasons.interaction: Answers are few and narrow or expensive (Arbalest Elite, Loran, Tower of Calamities, Molten-Tail Masticore), backed by tappers like Fiend Binder, protection from Cliffside Rescuer and Haystack, and the clumsy Worldslayer as the only reset.

details.summary: An unfocused mono-white Adeline deck with too many lands, little ramp and still-thin removal; it does not convincingly deliver the requested removal upgrade or cut its weakest cards.

reasons.plan: Most cards serve a mono-black Zombie sacrifice and reanimation plan around Sheoldred, with payoffs like Midnight Reaper, Vengeful Dead, Victimize and Fleshbag Marauder, but a handful are off-plan, such as Battle-Rage Blessing, Grisly Transformation, Render Inert and Curse of Disturbance.
reasons.fit: The curve now tops out with only one nonland card at 7+ besides the commander, but Necrotic Hex at seven mana is still in the deck, so the requested replacement of every 6+ card wasn't fully made.
reasons.mana: 33 lands suit a curve concentrated at 2-3 mana with heavy ramp, and a mono-black base of 30 Swamps plus Command Tower is dependable, with only Uncharted Haven entering tapped.
reasons.ramp: Around ten pieces (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Thought Vessel, Commander's Sphere, Heraldic Banner, Phyrexian Atlas, Hedron Archive, Unstable Obelisk, Wayfarer's Bauble, Pilgrim's Eye and Skittering Surveyor) comfortably support the seven-mana commander.
reasons.draw: Draw is plentiful and fits the sacrifice plan, with repeatable engines like Midnight Reaper, Undead Augur, Vampiric Rites, Gibbering Barricade, Spark Reaper and Braids, Arisen Nightmare plus one-shots like Phyrexian Rager, Skyscanner and Liliana's Standard Bearer.
reasons.interaction: There is a lot of removal, including Murder, Fell, Cut Down, Bone Splinters, Deadly Derision, Feed the Swarm, Final Flourish, Fleshbag Marauder, Syphon Flesh and Crippling Fear as a sweeper, but it is almost entirely creature-focused with little answer to artifacts or enchantments.

reasons.plan: There is a go-wide attack core of Adeline, Divine Visitation, Inquisitorial Rosette, Springjack Shepherd, Eidolon of Countless Battles, Waylay and Makindi Stampede, but well over a fifth of the deck is off-plan filler like Bargain, Tsabo's Web, Dawn-Blessed Pennant, Tower of Calamities, Darksteel Brute and The Dawning Archaic.
reasons.fit: The land count is now exactly 37 (35 Plains, Cactus Preserve, Makindi Mesas), but the creatures are mostly generic white bodies like Righteous Avengers, Silkenfist Order, Tine Shrike, Kami of the Palace Fields and Alpha Myr, with only a few, such as Springjack Shepherd, Eidolon and Worthy Knight, really suiting Adeline.
reasons.mana: Thirty-seven lands in a mono-white deck give dependable colours and suit a curve with 17 cards at five or more, with only two lands entering tapped.
reasons.ramp: Only Commander's Sphere, Darksteel Ingot, Luck Bobblehead and the one-shot Golden Egg and Magic Pot treasure accelerate mana, which is too little for 12 cards costing six or more.
reasons.draw: There are many small one-shot cantrips (Golden Egg, Scroll of Avacyn, Implement of Improvement, Fountain of Renewal, Wrench, Novice Inspector, Combat Thresher, Tsabo's Web), with Loran's symmetric draw and the narrow Harper Recruiter as the only repeatable sources.
reasons.interaction: Answers are few and clunky: Loran, Arbalest Elite, Tower of Calamities, Molten-Tail Masticore and Curse of Conformity, plus tappers and Cliffside Rescuer/Haystack protection, with Worldslayer as an impractical reset.

details.summary: The requested land cut was made, but the added creatures rarely suit Adeline's go-wide plan, and the deck is diluted by filler artifacts with thin ramp and removal. It is playable thanks to a solid mono-white mana base, but it is unfocused.
